svg.text: Dotnet · D03 · Producers can be covariant. List<T> cannot.
out produces. in consumes. List stays invariant.
Dogs as animals through IEnumerable — not List.
★ Reading Dog as Animal is safe. Adding a Cat through List<Animal> is not.
List<Animal> = dogs would let you Add a Cat.
IEnumerable<object> from strings is a read-only view.
2 — string is object; you never write through objects
Say produce, consume, write, read — then stop.
Direction first. Then the Cat story.

text.tspan: Explain by direction: produce vs consume
Why List<T> stays invariant — the Cat story
